create_vitl16_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-L/16 backbone model with 384x384 resolution and configurable readout strategy
create_vitb16_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-B/16 backbone model with 384x384 resolution for monocular depth estimation
create_deitb16_backbone: create a pretrained DeiT-B/16 backbone model with 384x384 resolution and hook-based feature extraction
create_vitb_rn50_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-B/RN50 hybrid backbone model combining ResNet50 and Vision Transformer features
run_forward_vit: run forward pass through pretrained ViT backbone to extract multi-scale feature maps from input image
